segments.an4.53:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā antarā ca madhuraṃ antarā ca verañjaṃ addhānamaggappaṭipanno hoti.
segments.an4.53:1.2: Sambahulāpi kho gahapatī ca gahapatāniyo ca antarā ca madhuraṃ antarā ca verañjaṃ addhānamaggappaṭipannā honti.
segments.an4.53:1.3: Atha kho bhagavā maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle ()[(paññatte āsane)(pī. ka.)] nisīdi.
segments.an4.53:1.4: Addasaṃsu kho gahapatī ca gahapatāniyo ca bhagavantaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinnaṃ.
segments.an4.53:1.5: Disvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te gahapatī ca gahapatāniyo ca bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.an4.53:2.3: Chavo chavāya saddhiṃ saṃvasati, chavo deviyā saddhiṃ saṃvasati, devo chavāya saddhiṃ saṃvasati, devo deviyā saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
segments.an4.53:3.2: Idha, gahapatayo, sāmiko hoti pāṇātipātī adinnādāyī kāmesumicchācārī musāvādī surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī dussīlo pāpadhammo maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati akkosakaparibhāsako samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ;
segments.an4.53:3.3: bhariyāpissa hoti pāṇātipātinī adinnādāyinī kāmesumicchācārinī musāvādinī surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyinī dussīlā pāpadhammā maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati akkosikaparibhāsikā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ.
segments.an4.53:3.4: Evaṃ kho, gahapatayo, chavo chavāya saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
segments.an4.53:4.2: Idha, gahapatayo, sāmiko hoti pāṇātipātī adinnādāyī kāmesumicchācārī musāvādī surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī dussīlo pāpadhammo maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati akkosakaparibhāsako samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ;

segments.an4.53:4.4: Evaṃ kho, gahapatayo, chavo deviyā saddhiṃ saṃvasati.

segments.an4.53:8.5: Sāpi devī saṃvasati, chavena patinā saha.
segments.an4.53:9.5: Sāpi chavā saṃvasati, devena patinā saha.

lines: Tatiye sambahulāpi kho gahapatī ca gahapatāniyo cāti bahukā gahapatayo ca gahapatāniyo ca āvāhavivāhakaraṇatthāya gacchantā tameva maggaṃ paṭipannā honti.
Chavo chavāyāti guṇamaraṇena matattā chavo guṇamaraṇeneva matāya chavāya saddhiṃ.
Akkosakaparibhāsakoti dasahi akkosavatthūhi akkosako, bhayaṃ dassetvā santajjanena paribhāsako.
Atthāsaṃ pacurā hontīti vaḍḍhisaṅkhātā atthā etesaṃ bahū honti.

lines: 53-54. Tatiye yathākammaṃ tā tā gatiyo aranti upagacchantīti ariyā, sattā.
Thaddhamacchariyasadisañhi kucchitaṃ sabbadā nihīnaṃ natthi sabbaguṇānaṃ ādibhūtassa bhogasampattiādisabbasampattīnaṃ mūlabhūtassa dānassa nisedhanato.
Ekacco hi attano vasanaṭṭhāne bhikkhū hatthaṃ pasāretvāpi na vandati.

Aññattha gato vihāraṃ pavisitvā sakkaccaṃ vanditvā madhurappaṭisanthāraṃ karoti “kiṃ, bhante, amhākaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ nāgacchatha, sampanno padeso, paṭibalāhaṃ ayyānaṃ yāgubhattādīhi upaṭṭhānaṃ kātun”ti.
Atheko thero tassa gāmaṃ gantvā piṇḍāya carati.
So taṃ disvā aññena vā gacchati, gharaṃ vā pavisati.
Sacepi sammukhībhāvaṃ āgacchati, hatthena vanditvā “ayyassa bhikkhaṃ detha, ahaṃ ekena kammena gacchāmī”ti pakkamati.
Yena samannāgato bhikkhūsu piṇḍāya paviṭṭhesu “therā ṭhitā”ti vutte “kiṃ mayhaṃ pādā rujjantī”tiādīni vatvā silāthambho viya khāṇuko viya ca thaddho hutvā tiṭṭhati, sāmīcimpi na karoti, kuto dānaṃ.
Tena vuttaṃ “thaddhamaccharinoti thaddhena maccharena samannāgatāti attho”ti.
Paribhāsakāti bhikkhū gharadvāre ṭhite disvā “kiṃ tumhe kasitvā āgatā vapitvā lāyitvā, mayaṃ attanopi na labhāma, kuto tumhākaṃ, sīghaṃ nikkhamathā”tiādīhi santajjakā.
Yācakānaṃ vacanassa atthaṃ jānantīti ettha kiñcāpi bhikkhū gharadvāre ṭhitā tuṇhī honti, atthato pana “bhikkhaṃ dethā”ti vadanti nāma ariyāya yācanāya.
Vuttañhetaṃ “uddissa ariyā tiṭṭhanti, esā ariyāna yācanā”ti (mi. pa.4.5.9).
Tatra ye “mayaṃ pacāma, ime na pacanti, pacamāne patvā alabhantā kuhiṃ labhissatī”ti deyyadhammaṃ saṃvibhajanti, te vadaññū yācakānaṃ vacanassa atthaṃ jānanti nāma ñatvā kattabbakaraṇato.
